survey: A cowboy hat seen from slightly above and in front, floating on a sunburst card background. Main parts: (1) The crown is a tall, rounded cylinder that rises from the middle of the brim, with one dent across the top. (2) A red band wraps all the way around the base of the crown and sits flush where the crown meets the brim. (3) The brim is a wide, flat oval that spreads out evenly from the base of the crown. Its underside is not visible, and its outer edge has a cream-colored raised binding. The brim has no upturned sides, which is a fine simplification. The hat floating with no surface below it is normal for an item card. The band, crown and brim all join where they should, and nothing passes through anything else. There are no loose ends and no invented parts.

errors.what: The crease is not a clean, symmetric cowboy-hat crease. It is one lopsided diagonal dent: the left front bulges up as a soft dome, and the back right rises to a higher lumpy peak. That makes the top look melted or squashed rather than shaped felt. There are no front pinches and no even center crease, so the crown reads as a blob with a dent.

fix: Give the crown a classic cattleman crease: one even dent running front to back down the center of the top, with two matching pinches at the front. The left and right sides of the crown should mirror each other, the top edges should be firm and clean, and there should be no lumpy or melted bulges. Keep the red band and the flat brim with its bound edge as they are.
